item: An unclean end carries its own session's peaks, what the memory was made of and the newest heavy snapshot; the boot names its build; a boots.json member lists the last ten boots with their ends
key_paths: src/monitoring/session_history.py; src/monitoring/session_hwm.py; src/monitoring/boots.py; src/monitoring/build_id.py; src/monitoring/path_tokens.py; docs/CHANGES.md; docs/ledger/LESSONS.md; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md
summary: Each unclean end record gains previous_peaks, previous_at_peak and previous_pressure from the sidecar of the session that died (refused when it names another process), each cut to 2,048 bytes with the cut named and every frame path tokenised; a heavy snapshot's guard block carries the release ladder's last record and a holders block read from plain counters (no connection, no lock); the boot record carries commit, source hash and schema head; boots.py builds the bundle member (export adds its bundle.py line). Recount of crash 091717: 105 of 186 samples at 64 MB or less, 122 under 100 MB, 66 inside 44 to 60 MB.
